input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in Article II(iii) runs to the Licensee alone, and the restrictions confine use and access to "the employees of the Licensee" (p0045) while barring any third-party access absent Licensor's prior written consent (p0041, p0042 also barring service-bureau/outsourcing use). Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are therefore excluded, with the only path being Licensor's discretionary consent — below the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice). Transfer is likewise blocked: p0149 requires Licensor's consent for any assignment and a Change of Control auto-terminates the licence absent consent (p0134), so there is no right to transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction, the second material fallback term. Redline adds Affiliates and contractors to the grant and to the access restrictions, and carves out a successor assignment. Separately noted (not flagged here, as it belongs to the termination rule): Article IV permits immediate termination on any breach without a materiality threshold or cure period, which makes the licence close to revocable at will.

proposal.summary: Extend the licence to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the licence to cover our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, since our introducing-broker operations are conducted through affiliated entities and outsourced support, and the current employees-only grant would put ordinary use in breach. We have also preserved continuity by allowing transfer of the licence to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; if you prefer, we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice to you.

ops.oldText: grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use
ops.newText: grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use

ops.oldText: (b) disclose any Licensed Technology to, or permit the use or access of any Licensed Technology by, any third party for any reason without the prior written consent of Licensor;
ops.newText: (b) disclose any Licensed Technology to, or permit the use or access of any Licensed Technology by, any third party (other than Licensee's Affiliates and contractors acting on Licensee's behalf, in each case bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those in this Agreement) for any reason without the prior written consent of Licensor;

ops.oldText: by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee for use in the Field of Use.
ops.newText: by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf, in each case for use in the Field of Use.

ops.oldText: in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
ops.newText: in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent, except that Licensee may assign this Agreement and its license rights hereunder, without Licensor's consent, to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity.
